# Senses Montessori School

Senses is a bilingual Montessori school and nursery in Brooklin Paulista, São Paulo, Brazil. The school serves early childhood through three programs: Bebê Cientista, Cientista Júnior (approximately 18 months to 3 years), and Cientista Sênior (3 to 6 years).

The school practices Montessori education through a prepared environment, hands-on materials, child-sized spaces, mixed-age learning, observation by trained educators, freedom within clear limits, practical life, sensory exploration, and daily contact with nature. English is introduced from nursery and becomes an immersion experience in the Junior and Senior groups after adaptation.

The campus is at R. Princesa Isabel, 445, Brooklin Paulista, São Paulo, in the former home of writer and bibliophile José Mindlin. The school states that it has 600 m² of green area.

- [Educational journal](https://sensesschool.com.br/blog/): articles for families about Montessori and childhood development.
